description:
The Agent Toolbox: agentic build tools (Cline, Aider, OpenHands, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Devin, Jules, Kiro, Amp, Warp, n8n, Browser Use and more) by category.
Use when: the user wants agent options of a kind (CLI, IDE, autonomous SWE, browser, workflow), MCP servers, AI coding models, or stack pieces (hosting, database, auth, payments) with dated official pricing, or only open-source ones.
Do not use for: harness features such as MCP or sandboxing (list_harnesses).
Returns: per tool: what, best_for, licence (GitHub-checked, with date), pricing with source and pricing_checked, last_checked.
Limits: category is one of the enum values; open_source true filters to open source.
Example: {"category":"CLI agent","open_source":true}

category.description: Category (agents, plus MCP servers, AI coding models, hosting, databases, auth, payments).

name: list_agent_tools
title: List agentic coding tools
